summary: OceanLight Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting the closings of its SPAC IPO, the underwriters' full exercise of the over-allotment option, and a related private placement. The IPO comprised 10,000,000 units at $10.00 each ($100M gross), plus 1,500,000 option units at $10.00 each ($15M), and 7,500 private placement units to the sponsor for $75,000. The filing includes a pro forma balance sheet. No acquisition, merger, or other special-situation event is announced; this is a routine capital-formation disclosure.
